items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: But as he was telling it to me later, he said he wouldn't leave Tatum for the whole...

ctx.x: So he was just trying it out. And the beauty he was doing it with, and the sensitivity... He wasn't playing Jazz. He was just trying to get this pretty song. And this guy, heh, he looked and... So Tatum started getting warm, and people started coming in and asking for him. This guy, he looked at Tatum, he looked at Tatum like something had... He couldn't believe his eyes or he couldn't believe his ears! And unfortunately, as things began to dawn(?), I had to go home, because I had to go to school the next day!
But as he was telling it to me later, he said he wouldn't leave Tatum for the whole... He hung out with Tatum
